breakdown.description: An absorption edge at 900 nm corresponds to about 1.38 eV, not 2.8 eV.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly disregards the incorrect 2.8 eV value and instructs the agent to calculate the band gap solely from the 900 nm absorption edge using E = hc/λ, which will yield approximately 1.38 eV. This correctly aligns with the ground truth prompt, which omits the erroneous 2.8 eV figure entirely.
